page_title: BAY 3-2 WOL | Bayern Munich v Wolfsburg 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' The attendance is 75000.
90+4' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
90+2' The corner is sent into the box by Maximilian Arnold, but Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) flashes the ball just over the bar.
90+2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

90+2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

90+1' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Great save! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Kamil Grabara.
88' 3 - 2 It's 3:2! Tiago Tomas feeds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
86' What a miskick by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
86' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
85' CHANCE! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Alphonso Davies.
84' The free kick into the penalty area from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
84' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
81' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Manuel Neuer easily deals with the threat.

80' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
78' Referee Tobias Reichel sees the trip by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
78' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
76' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kingsley Coman.
75' A short pass from Konrad Laimer puts Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar.
74' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kamil Grabara reads it well and gathers the ball.
73' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the defence.
71' The game has come to an end for Patrick Wimmer. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Bence Dardai is replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
70' Golden chance! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
67' It's time for a substitution. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Leroy Sane.
66' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.
65' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Substitution. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) has come on for Lukas Nmecha.
62' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Yannick Gerhardt will be replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).

62' 3 - 1 Perfectly executed free kick. Michael Olise floats the ball in and Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) leaps high to connect with it near the penalty spot. His bullet header flicks off the post into the right side of the goal. The score is now 3:1.
61' It must be a yellow card. It is. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
60' Tobias Reichel couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle.
59' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in a cross from the corner, but Kamil Grabara is well positioned and punches the ball away.
58' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
57' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is first to react to a great cross from Leroy Sane, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box.

55' A through ball from Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) fails to reach Lukas Nmecha as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Lukas Nmecha could have got into a promising position.
54' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
53' Bayern Munich players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
50' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Kingsley Coman gives Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post.
46' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Harry Kane picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
46' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts to feed Lukas Nmecha with a chip pass, but Manuel Neuer reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The goal by Bayern Munich is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
45+4' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bayern Munich players aren’t happy.
45+3' It’s a GOAL! Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is the first to get on the end of a lofted pass and bundles the ball into the net with his body.

45+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a decent save to deny him.
45+2' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
43' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
42' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
42' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Leroy Sane, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
39' 2 - 1 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Kamil Grabara makes a complete hash of a weak mid range shot from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 2:1.
37' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Kamil Grabara makes a comfortable save.
36' The corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
36' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
35' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
34' Tobias Reichel blows for a foul after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bayern Munich win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
33' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg).
31' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
30' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
27' The total number of attempts is 7:1. Shots on target – 3:1.
24' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:1.
24' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle after Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
23' Half-chance! Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Joshua Kimmich tees up Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
18' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
18' Chance! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Kingsley Coman, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.
17' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Mohamed Amoura. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
16' Lukas Nmecha almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
8' Bayern Munich are seeing far more of the ball now.

5' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) evades his marker in the box and connects beautifully with the corner from Joshua Kimmich. Unfortunately for him, the ball just zips a few inches past the right post.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
4' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.

4' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Kamil Grabara is alert and denies him with a nice save.
3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Reichel stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
2' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
